summary: Tested Final Polish Task 2 (per-trip `summary` on GET /api/trips + TripCard rendering). Wrote /app/backend/tests/trip_summary_test.py (9 tests, all pass): summary shape/defaults on fresh trip (total_km=null, cost=0.0, has_missing_rates=false), total_km aggregation (100 + 50.5 = 150.5), cost aggregation with FX conversion (200 EUR hotel + 50 USD @0.9 = 245.0), missing-rate item excluded + flag=true (100 EUR hotel + 30 GBP = 100.0/true), attractions incl. zero-cost, user isolation (alice vs bob), 3-trip multi-trip response, regression on GET/PATCH /trips/{id} and /trips/{id}/summary, 401 for unauthenticated. Code-reviewed list_trips: 1 trip_members query + 1 trips query + 5 batched child queries via asyncio.gather -> no N+1; _id excluded everywhere. Full regression suite: 241/241 pass. Frontend Playwright on the public URL verified TripCard: full trip '151 km' / '€245.00', missing-rates trip '€100.00' + amber AlertTriangle with aria-label + working tooltip 'Alcuni costi esclusi (tassi mancanti)' that does NOT navigate on click, empty trip '— km' / '€0.00' (zero renders), card link navigation still works, no console/page errors.

minor.issue: /app/backend/.env had ORS_MOCK="0" so km auto-calc hit the live OpenRouteService API, which returns HTTP 429 (rate-limited) in this preview -> every km computation returned null/km_calc_error=true and 21 pre-existing phase5 tests failed. I set ORS_MOCK="1" (documented default in /app/memory/test_credentials.md), restarted backend, and cleared the polluted db.geocode_cache (real-ORS coords for fake cities like 'xyzzy-unknown' leaked into the cache and made mock mode resolve unknown cities). After that 241/241 tests pass. Decide whether ORS_MOCK=0 was intentional; if so, km features are effectively broken in preview due to ORS quota.

issues: formatKm uses Math.round so 150.5 km renders as '151 km' (0.5 km precision lost). Cosmetic/expected-value nit only — confirm rounding is intended.
Radix tooltip renders above the card and visually overlaps the date row ('Sep 1, 2026 → Sep 5, 2026'); readable but slightly cramped.

action_items: Confirm intended value of ORS_MOCK in /app/backend/.env (I flipped it back to 1; live ORS key is 429-limited in preview).
critical_code_review_comments: list_trips aggregation is correct and bounded (7 queries total regardless of trip count); attractions query filters {cost: {$ne: null, $gt: 0}} while hotels/expenses coerce null cost to 0 — behaviour is consistent for totals but the asymmetry is worth a comment.
Summary is computed inline in list_trips and duplicates the conversion logic that also exists in summary.py; if a third consumer appears, extract a shared helper (no change needed now).
seed_data_creation: User uitrips@twt.app with 3 trips left in DB for verification: TEST_UI_Full (150.5 km / 245 EUR), TEST_UI_Missing (100 EUR + has_missing_rates), TEST_UI_Empty (null km / 0 cost). Re-runnable via /app/test_reports/seed_ui_task2.py. Other TEST_* data cleaned up by fixtures.
context_for_next_testing_agent: ORS_MOCK must stay "1" for deterministic km tests; if km tests fail unexpectedly, also clear db.geocode_cache (stale real-ORS coords for fake cities break mock mode). New regression file: /app/backend/tests/trip_summary_test.py.
rca_of_the_issue: The 21 initial phase5 failures were environmental, not a regression from Task 2: ORS_MOCK=0 made the app call the real ORS API, which answers 429 for /v2/directions, so km_from_prev stayed null. A secondary effect was geocode_cache persisting real-ORS coordinates for intentionally-invalid city names, which kept 2 tests failing even after enabling the mock. Fix: ORS_MOCK=1 + purge geocode_cache.
